services.name: Erie Fishing
services.desc: Lake Erie, known for its vast waters and thriving fish population, offers some of the best sportfishing opportunities in the Great Lakes region. Liberty Charters LLC is proud to be a leading outfitter, guiding anglers through this exceptional fishing territory. Operating out of Oak Harbor, OH, we specialize in Lake Erie fishing charters that provide access to world-class waters, whether you're a seasoned angler or a beginner. With years of experience and local knowledge, we ensure you have a memorable and successful fishing adventure, targeting the lake's prized species in one of the most productive and scenic regions of Ohio. services.name: Oak Harbor Fishing Charter
services.desc: Get ready to reel in some of Lake Erie's finest catches on this 7-hour fishing trip out of Oak Harbor, OH. Our 30' Baha cruiser is your ticket to some of the best walleye, perch, and bass fishing in the Great Lakes. Whether you're a seasoned angler or just getting your feet wet, our experienced captains know exactly where the fish are biting and how to put you on them. We'll set out from Oak Harbor bright and early (or later if you prefer an afternoon trip) and cruise to the hottest fishing spots on Lake Erie. Our spacious 30-footer has plenty of room for up to 6 anglers, so bring your buddies or the whole family. We provide all the gear you need - quality rods, reels, lures, and live bait.
